thread:
maria: Auditor Jane asked for a SOC2 sample tied to incident INC-2026-117. They want an evidence package: RBAC change events, KMS key rotation metadata (no plaintext keys), and correlated audit logs for a 1-hour window centered on the incident. Can we produce a manifest with checksums + short README for provenance?

sam: Clarifying qs: 1) exact window = 30m before/after incident (total 1h)? 2) We'll include KMS events (GenerateDataKey, Encrypt, Decrypt, Rotate) and IAM roleBinding diffs. 3) They want JSONL lines with timestamp, actor, action, resource, request_id, raw_event. Is that acceptable?

auditor_jane: Yes to all. Window = 30m before and after. Provide cloud KMS audit events, keystore rotation records (timestamps + key version IDs), and any service account permission grants/revocations. JSONL format + a single evidence-manifest.jsonl listing files and sha256. Please include S3 presigned URLs and note who uploaded.

raj: We only retain detailed RBAC diffs for 180 days; within the 1-hour window we can export full diffs. Will stage artifacts to s3://redwood-audit-evidence/soc2-INC-2026-117/.

sam: I'll run Splunk/ELK query scoped to unix times and redact user emails. Query to run:

```
index=redwood-audit (iam OR roleBinding OR KMS) earliest=1813334200 latest=1813334800 | sort 0 _time | table _time, user, action, resource, request_id, raw_event
```

ops-bot: Export job queued: exp-20260324-07, ETA ~10m. Destination s3://redwood-audit-evidence/soc2-INC-2026-117/exp-20260324-07/

olivia: Heads-up: external auditor S3 access requires approval from Security Lead. I'll file the access ticket and include the approval timestamp in the manifest. cc @maria.

maria: Plan: 1) run query and collect 4 artifacts: a) kms-events.jsonl b) rbac-diffs.jsonl c) iam-approvals.csv d) evidence-manifest.jsonl + README.txt. 2) compute sha256 for each file, upload, generate presigned urls, post manifest. Will record uploader and approval id in manifest.

ops-bot: Export complete: exp-20260324-07 uploaded 4 files. presigned_urls_sent_to=auditor_jane@externaldomain.com. evidence-manifest.jsonl at s3://redwood-audit-evidence/soc2-INC-2026-117/evidence-manifest.jsonl

auditor_jane: Got the links; validating checksums now. If anything mismatches I'll flag. Thanks for quick turnaround.

sam: Note for the record: we redacted PII (emails replaced with user IDs) and included request_id correlation for cross-system tracing.

maria: Closing loop: approval ticket ID SEC-2026-459 included in manifest. Leaving this thread open if auditor requests follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
